chapter.verse: Tua bangin Khazih in ama pumpi-in gimna thuak ahih ciangin, note in zong a nung ciangin mite deihna bang zui loin,
Pasian’ deihna bang zui-in, na pumpi uh a nuntakna a om lai hun a bei dongin, tua bang lungsim nei-in om un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, gimna a thuak mi in mawhna tawh a kikhen hi.
Gentailte’ deihna zui-in lunggulhna a nin deihgawhna, leenggahzu khamna, pawikhamna, tam dawn luatna, a kihhuai milim biakna-ah om theih nading hunte a kicing ta hi.
Tua hihnate-ah note in amaute tawh kipawlin noptatna-ah kihhuaina na bawl lohna uh amaute in lamdangsa-in hong ko thei uh hi.
Tua mite in a nungta mite leh a si mite tungah thukhen dingin a om kholpa mai-ah thusuahna a thuak ding uh hi.
Tua hanginah a nungta mite in a thuak uh bangin pumpi tawh thukhenna a thuak uh hangin Pasian’ deihna tawh kituak kha tawh a nuntak theih nadingun mi site kiangah Lungdamna Thu a kihilh zo hi.
Na khempeuh a beina hong nai zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin pha takpi kikeemin pil un, thungenin ngak un.
Hihna khempeuh tham loin, note in khat leh khat nakpi-in na ki-it un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ki-itna in mawhna tampi a seel hi.
Phun loin khat leh khat zin na kido un.
Note in hehpihna letsong na ngah ciat uh mah bangin Pasian’ hehpihna thupha atuamtuam a keem mi phate bangin, khat leh khat na kihawm un.

Pasian in na khempeuhah Topa Zeisu hangin phatna a ngah theih nadingin, mi khatpeuh in thu a hilh leh, Pasian’ thupiak bangin hilh ta hen; mi khatpeuh in na a sep leh, Pasian piak tha bangin sem ta hen. Tua Pasian in a tawntungin minthan’na leh vangliatna nei ta hen. Amen.
Ka itte aw, note hong ze-et nadingin na thuak uh mei tawh kisit, bawlsiatna in note tungah lamdangsak huaina ahi ci-in ngaihsun kei un, na lungmang kei un.
Note in Khazih’ gimna a zom na hih uh ciangin ama minthan’na hong kilat ciangin lungdam mahmahna tawh na nuam nadingun, tu-in zong nuam un.
Khazih’ min hangin kosiatna na thuak uh leh, thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, minthan’na tawh kipawl kha ahi Pasian’ Kha Siangtho in note tungah a om hi.
Note lakah kuamah in mi that mi bang ahi zongin, mi sumgu mi bang ahi zongin, a gilo hih bang ahi zongin, midangte’ thusia-a kihel mi bang ahi zongin thuak kei hen.
Ahih hangin Christian ahihna hangin gimna a thuak mi khat a om leh, zum kei hen; ahih hangin tua min puakna hangin Pasian’ min phat ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ innkuante a masa belin thukhen nading hun a tung zo hi. Eite a masa-in thu hong khen leh, Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu a mang lo mite bang suak ding ahi hiam?
“Mi dikte in gupna ngah nading haksa ahih leh, Pasian a nei lo, mawhna a nei mite in bang suak ding ahi uh hiam?”
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian’ deihna bangin gimna a thuak mite in, a pha a gamtatna uh zomin, thuman ahi amaute a Bawlpa’ khut sungah amau kha uh pia ta uh hen.
